question: Who among the following secured India's first Paris 2024 Olympic quota in rowing?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Balraj Panwar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Balraj Panwar** secured **India’s first Paris 2024 Olympic quota** in rowing by achieving remarkable performance at an international qualifying event.
 
• He earned the quota in the **Men’s Single Sculls category**, demonstrating a high level of endurance, technique, and skill.
 
• The qualifying event took place at the **Asian Rowing Championships**, which is a significant competition for Olympic qualification in the sport.
 
• Balraj Panwar represented India and competed against top athletes from across Asia, securing his position for the prestigious Olympic Games.
 
• This achievement highlights the growing prominence of Indian athletes in global rowing competitions and sets the stage for further advancements in the sport.
